title: Wi-Fi Experience Optimisation

label: For "Wi-Fi Experience Optimisation": Tune channel, power and access point placement recommendations from client experience data so wireless issues fall, using access point and client-class aggregates and not named users. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Signal strength as the target.
